answers.q2_detail: Full register HTML is server-rendered (PosRegisterController + register/index.php + data-pos-register) ONLY after biometric session; not a client-only SPA. JS enhances after load.
answers.q3_detail: PosRegisterController redirects to biometric when !isPosVerified; gate HTML ≠ register HTML.
answers.q4_detail: Warm/fetch followed redirect → biometric gate HTML (~6KB) stored in coexist/ops. SW putShell intentionally skips pinning biometric as register shell.
answers.q5_detail: POS navigations use isPosNavigation → shellFallback (rateb-pos-shell-v8 / OFFLINE_HTML). ERP modules use neverFailNavigate → ops-pages/coexist. Cached gate in coexist is ignored for POS offline navigate.

root_cause.summary: Without an active POS biometric session, /admin/ops/pos/register never returns register HTML (302→biometric). Warm caches the gate; offline POS pipeline requires data-pos-register in rateb-pos-shell-v8 and intentionally will not use gate HTML, so it falls back to OFFLINE_HTML stub.
root_cause.legal_note: Biometric gate is an intentional second factor after ERP login (session flag pos_biometric_verified_at). Caching/serving full register without verification would bypass POS cashier biometric policy. Full offline register snapshot is only obtainable after a successful online biometric unlock (then SW putShell pins data-pos-register).
